# .github/workflows/

GitHub Actions. `ci.yml` runs on every push to `main` and every pull request: pipeline lint, type check, tests and catalogue check; web lint, type check, unit tests, build and a browser smoke test. Actions are pinned by commit SHA with the version in a comment; Dependabot proposes updates monthly.

Scheduled data jobs and release workflows arrive with later prompts (D04, O01).
